target_customer: Small contractors and trade businesses (painters, roofers, plumbers, electricians, movers) who pay a monthly subscription
problem: Contractors lose time and money on quotes, contracts, invoices and payment chasing; Clickpad offers an AI assistant they text like a crew member.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, plans from US$49 per month

founders.name: Harry Grewal
founders.background_notes: YC page: started in construction at 16 and spent 17 years in property improvement and technology; WeReno facilitated over 1 billion dollars of renovation and capital projects per the page.

technical_complexity.rationale: The original WeReno was a renovation project platform; the current product uses LLM agents over text, calls and WhatsApp, which is application layer work.

defensibility.rationale: Customer data and contractor workflows give modest stickiness, but AI assistants for trades are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found in sources.

market_need_then: The batch product WeReno targeted renovation and capital projects; the YC page says it facilitated over 1 billion dollars of projects. Demand evidence for the later AI assistant is limited to its pricing page.

branding.domain_note: Uses clickpad.com; how it was obtained was not found.

identity.logo: Simple bold black and white wordmark
identity.mascot_or_character: Click, the AI assistant that introduces itself as Hi, I'm Click
identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, direct, text-like; Your business. Click's job.

rebrands.why: YC page states WeReno is now ClickPad.com; reason not given

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly named assistant is a clear touch, but no press or community evidence found.

pivots.from: WeReno, renovation and property maintenance platform
pivots.to: Clickpad, AI back office assistant for contractors
pivots.why: not stated; YC page says WeReno is now ClickPad.com

outcome_analysis: A construction industry founder entered YC as WeReno and has since rebranded and refocused as Clickpad, an AI texting assistant for contractors with 12 team members per the YC page. No verified funding, revenue or exit appears in the sources found, so the outcome is unresolved and the company is active.
notes: Funding unverified: an aggregator (VCBacked) lists WeReno at 2.3M total with a pre-seed announced October 2022 from Y Combinator, FundersClub, Atento Capital, Eight Capital and an angel; single aggregator source so not a round. A YC profile snippet for WeReno lists Manny Dhaliwal as COO but the Clickpad YC page lists only Harry Grewal, so he is not recorded as a founder. Competitor search for WeReno returned conflicting undated lists (Renowyze, Foresight, Knowify, Houzz, Porch), none dated near 2022, so the list is empty. Outcome search found no news on Clickpad. Completeness pass: one round recorded on the strength of a single database or outlet, VCBacked, with Extruct giving the same amount and date 2022-10-03 (company was then called WeReno). No primary announcement found.
